verdict.rationale: The Division documents an online Business Formation service for filing certificates of formation (docs-35). It positions the Premier Business Services account as an option for businesses that file frequently or need shared staff payment access (docs-37), which implies occasional founders can start without an account. However, no published page explicitly says formation can begin without an account, and no business-ID or file-number entry path is described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the formation flow requires no login, a documented file-number or business-ID entry path for existing-entity filings, and hands-on corroboration.
